article_content: Actress Nicole Kidman has shared how her husband, country music star Keith Urban, helped her cope with the loss of her father Dr. Antony Kidman, who passed away in Singapore at age 75 in September 2014. Despite her grief, the Oscar winner has maintained her professional schedule, recently participating in China's Mission Hills Celebrity Pro-Am event. 'Having a supportive partner during difficult times is essential,' remarked Kidman, 47. 'My husband was extraordinary after Dad's passing. I'm fortunate to have found him after a long search.' The actress prioritizes family time at her Nashville home with Urban and their children, where she enjoys running, swimming, and golf. At the Hainan Island event, she connected with Hollywood peers including Morgan Freeman and received golf coaching from Australian legend Greg Norman, who rated her potential as 'six out of ten' and praised her dedication. Norman shared: 'Nicole aims to become proficient within a decade. With regular practice, she could achieve this in a year. Her mental preparedness is impressive.' Kidman will partner with English golfer Ian Poulter in the tournament's upcoming rounds.
translated_content: 배우 니콜 키드먼이 지난 2014년 9월 75세를 일기로 세상을 떠난 아버지 앤토니 키드먼 박사의 상을 치르는 동안 남편인 컨트리 가수 키스 어번의 지원이 큰 힘이 되었다고 전했습니다. 오스카 수상 경력의 배우는 슬픔 속에서도 중국 하이난도에서 개최된 미션힐스 셀러브리티 프로암 대회 참가 등 프로 활동을 이어갔습니다. '힘든 시기에 함께해줄 동반자가 있다는 건 정말 중요해요.' 47세의 키드먼은 전하며, '아버지가 돌아가신 후 남편은 정말 든든한 버팀목이 되어줬어요. 오랜 시간 끝에 찾은 소중한 사람이죠'라고 말했습니다. 니콜은 네슈빌 자택에서 남편과 아이들과 보내는 시간을 최우선으로 여기며, 달리기와 수영, 골프를 즐기고 있습니다. 이번 행사에서는 모건 프리먼 등 할리우드 동료들과 교류하는 한편, 호주 출신의 골프 전설 그렉 노먼에게 코칭을 받으며 '10점 만점에 6점'이라는 평가와 함께 성장 가능성을 인정받았습니다. 노먼은 '니콜은 10년 안에 제대로 된 실력을 갖추겠다는 목표를 세웠어요. 주기적인 연습만 한다면 1년 만에도 충분히 가능한 일이죠. 정신력이 매우 강인하네요'라고 언급했습니다. 앞으로의 경기에서는 영국의 골프 스타 이안 폴터와 팀을 이룰 예정입니다.

article_content: A wildlife photographer captured a remarkable optical illusion of a two-headed horse while birdwatching in Wales. Geoffrey Baker, 57, visited Three Cliffs Bay on the Gower Peninsula to test camera equipment with a friend. After an unsuccessful birdwatching session, they observed wild ponies nearby. Using his Nikon D3 camera with a 200-400mm lens and 1.7x converter, Baker photographed a pony turning its head as another stood behind it. The telephoto lens compressed the distance between the animals, creating the illusion of a two-headed creature. Baker only noticed the effect during image review, stating: 'This accidental shot surpassed any planned bird photo!' Optical experts explain that telephoto lenses can flatten perspective over distances, causing such visual effects.

article_content: Disgraced Chinese politician Bo Xilai revealed an illicit affair between his wife and former aide during the conclusion of China's most significant political trial in three decades. In his final testimony at the five-day Jinan proceedings, the former Chongqing Communist Party secretary denied embezzlement and bribery charges totaling £2.7 million, while accusing his wife Gu Kailai and ex-police chief Wang Lijun of misconduct. Xilai claimed: 'Wang Lijun was secretly in love with Gu Kailai, creating emotional entanglements he couldn't escape.' Prosecutors emphasized 'extremely grave crimes' warranting severe punishment, referencing Xilai's interference in the Neil Heywood murder investigation. While facing corruption charges that carry maximum capital punishment, Xilai admitted familial governance failures but maintained innocence. The case revealed connections to the 2011 murder of British businessman Heywood, for which Gu Kailai was convicted, and detailed financial misconduct involving international properties and misused government funds.
